info.name: VergePay API - full test suite
info.description: Every end-to-end test of vergepay_api, including the edge cases. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner, or `npm run test:postman`). Needs the two stand-ins (`npm run flw:stand-in`, `npm run alpaca:stand-in`), the API (`npm run start:with-stand-in`) and the worker (`npm run worker:with-stand-in`), with REDIS_URL set. Always call http://localhost (the cookie jar is per host). Expected results: postman/EXPECTED_RESULTS.md.

variable.description: INTERNAL_API_KEY from .env (the back-office key). npm run test:postman fills it in.
The webhook secret hash. Matches npm run start:with-stand-in.
